takehome._说明: 作品带回家规则。mode=year：一年 free 件免费，只在成品化周挑；mode=semester：每学期 free 件免费（W1–W18 上学期、W19–W36 下学期），做完可以当场带回家。

L1.rule: 一年三件免费：3 月、7 月、11 月最后一个星期六的成品化周（成品化①②③）各从之前的作品挑一件带回家，第四件起加购。作品做完先拍照、存程序、拆掉，不当场带回家。
L1.rule_en: Three free take-homes a year: at each finishing week (last Saturday of March, July and November) pick one earlier project to take home. From the 4th project it costs extra. After each project, take photos, save the code and take it apart.

L2.rule: 一年三件免费：3 月、7 月、11 月最后一个星期六的成品化周（成品化①②③）各从之前的作品挑一件带回家，第四件起加购。作品做完先拍照、存程序、拆掉，不当场带回家。
L2.rule_en: Three free take-homes a year: at each finishing week (last Saturday of March, July and November) pick one earlier project to take home. From the 4th project it costs extra. After each project, take photos, save the code and take it apart.

default.rule: 每学期一件免费（W1–W18 上学期、W19–W36 下学期），同一学期第二件起自费。做完可以选「现在带回家」，或「先不决定」到学期末成品化周再挑。
default.rule_en: One free take-home per semester (W1–W18, W19–W36); more in the same semester cost extra. Take it home now, or decide later and pick one at the end-of-semester finishing week.
